output.summary: A rating nearly slipped on hydraulic oil at crane 2. It is a repeat leak. Two sister vessels reported the same pattern this week.
contributing_factors: Recurring hydraulic hose leak not repaired
No drip tray or absorbent at the crane pedestal

ism_check.reason: The hazard is a physical condition on deck.

severity_check.reason: Matched corpus case resulted in a fracture; recurrence raises likelihood.

corrective_actions: Replace the weeping hose on crane 2
preventive_actions: Fit drip trays at all crane pedestals
Add hydraulic hose checks to weekly rounds

corpus_match_reasons.why: Same precursor: recurring leak at a crane pedestal led to a slip and fracture.

similar_tickets.title_en: AB slipped at crane pedestal, no drip tray

corpus_matches.title: Slip on oil-contaminated deck at crane pedestal
corpus_matches.why: Same precursor: recurring leak at a crane pedestal.
